minutes.summary: The Building Design Committee reviewed the chair's rough sketch for consolidating nearly all town office functions into the Ritter building, with the old Town Hall becoming a meeting house/PACC studio space. Members raised concerns about space adequacy, storage, ADA/elevator needs and the lack of real input from department heads, and voted to appoint a three-person subcommittee (Tony, Matt, Laura) to gather department space needs before any floor plan is drawn; one member registered ongoing reservations about whether Ritter is really the best site versus other options.

what_happened.line: Committee voted unanimously to form a three-member subcommittee to survey department heads on space needs before any floor plan is drawn.
Chair presented a sketch consolidating nearly all town office functions into the Ritter building, with old Town Hall becoming a meeting house and PACC studio.
One member dissented, questioning whether Ritter is the right site and raising selling Ritter or revisiting the TC Pacios building as alternatives.
Old Town Hall is being treated as effectively settled as the site for the Select Board and the PACC studio, pending no change in direction.
Committee will skip its December 15 meeting and reconvene January 5 to review the subcommittee's draft interview questions.

why_it_matters: This concerns where town government offices and the Select Board would physically operate, a decision that precedes any building or renovation budget request.
No dollar figure is settled yet; the only cost estimate discussed was described as outdated, so a capital cost for this project is not yet established.
Department heads have not yet been formally asked about their space needs, which the committee itself says must happen before a floor plan is drawn.
